delivery: Reviewed silent 4-6 second MP4 clips; natural repeat; static camera; no zoom-only animation. Keep people and action objects visible. Pause available. No runtime generation.
workflow: For existing empty backgrounds, first create an action-filled keyframe with the listed people. Generate clip from that keyframe, inspect anatomy and action, commit MP4 and matching poster; then set PIC_SCENES motionSrc. Do not point motionSrc at missing clips.

scenes.ko: 생일 파티! 친구들은 무엇을 하고 있나요?
scenes.en: Birthday party! What are the friends doing?
scenes.action: Child blows out candles; two friends clap; friend offers a gift.

scenes.ko: 운동장 놀이! 누가 공을 차고 있나요?
scenes.en: Playground fun! Who is kicking the ball?
scenes.action: Children pass a soccer ball; child jumps rope; friend cheers.

scenes.ko: 가족 요리! 각자 무엇을 만들고 있나요?

scenes.action: Child stirs batter; child places berries; parent flips a pancake.

scenes.action: Children build a sandcastle; parent carries water; child tosses a beach ball.

scenes.action: Guide points to a monkey; child looks through binoculars; monkey swings.

scenes.en: A magic castle! There is a dragon and a wizard.
scenes.action: Wizard waves a wand; friendly dragon flaps wings; child opens a gate.

scenes.en: A tasty restaurant! What will you order?

scenes.action: Diver waves; turtle swims; school of fish turns together.

scenes.en: A robot workshop! Build your own robot.
scenes.action: Child tightens a robot screw; friend passes a tool; robot waves.

scenes.ko: 서커스에 왔어요! 제일 재미있는 건 뭘까?
scenes.en: The circus is here! What is the most fun part?
scenes.action: Juggler tosses balls; acrobat balances; audience claps.

scenes.ko: 축구 경기! 우리 팀이 이길 수 있을까?

scenes.action: Player kicks ball; goalkeeper reaches; teammate cheers.

scenes.en: A birthday party! What will you wish for?
scenes.action: Child blows out candles; friends clap and give presents.

scenes.en: A haunted house! Are you brave enough to go in?
scenes.action: Children open a door; friendly ghost waves; child points at ghost.

scenes.en: Morning at the farm! Which animals are there?
scenes.action: Child feeds chickens; farmer carries basket; child picks vegetables.

scenes.ko: 동물원 나들이! 제일 보고 싶은 동물은?
scenes.en: A day at the zoo! Which animal do you want to see most?
scenes.action: Keeper feeds giraffe; children point and take a photo.

scenes.en: At the bakery! What will you choose?
scenes.action: Baker kneads dough; child chooses bread; clerk hands over a bag.

scenes.en: At the library! Which book will you read?
scenes.action: Child turns pages; librarian hands a book; friend writes notes.

scenes.en: The playground! What will you play with your friends?
scenes.action: Child slides; friend swings; two children play catch.

scenes.ko: 눈 오는 날! 무엇을 만들어 볼까?
scenes.en: A snowy day! What will you build?
scenes.action: Children roll snowball; friend places carrot nose; child waves.

scenes.ko: 비 오는 날! 우산 쓰고 어디 갈까?
scenes.en: A rainy day! Where will you go with your umbrella?
scenes.action: Child opens umbrella; friend steps around puddle; parent shares umbrella.

scenes.en: At the market! What will you buy?
scenes.action: Seller weighs apples; parent pays; child carries a basket.

scenes.en: A night at the campsite! What story will you tell?
scenes.action: Parent pitches tent; child unrolls sleeping bag; friend shines flashlight.

scenes.en: A train trip! What can you see out the window?
scenes.action: Child waves through window; parent points outside; conductor checks tickets.

scenes.en: At the airport! Where are you flying to?
scenes.action: Family rolls suitcases; staff scans boarding pass; child waves goodbye.

scenes.ko: 병원에 갔어요! 의사 선생님이 뭐라고 하실까?
scenes.en: A visit to the clinic! What will the doctor say?
scenes.action: Doctor listens with stethoscope; child breathes deeply; parent comforts child.

scenes.en: A visit to the fire station! Will you ride the fire truck?
scenes.action: Firefighter demonstrates hose; child tries helmet; classmates clap.

scenes.en: At the aquarium! Which fish did you meet?
scenes.action: Children point to passing fish; guide explains; child draws a turtle.

scenes.en: The music room! Which instrument will you play?
scenes.action: Child plays drums; friend strums guitar; teacher conducts.

scenes.en: Art class! What will you draw?
scenes.action: Child paints; friend shapes clay; teacher displays artwork.

scenes.ko: 운동회 날! 우리 팀이 이길 수 있을까?
scenes.en: Sports day! Can your team win?
scenes.action: Children run relay; runner passes baton; friends cheer.

scenes.en: A picnic in the park! What is in your lunch box?
scenes.action: Parent pours water; child passes sandwiches; friend spreads blanket.

scenes.ko: 나무 위 오두막! 여기서 무엇을 할까?
scenes.en: A treehouse! What will you do up there?
scenes.action: Child climbs ladder; friend opens door; child hoists basket with rope.

scenes.ko: 열기구를 타고 하늘로! 아래에 무엇이 보일까?
scenes.en: Up in a hot air balloon! What can you see below?
scenes.action: Pilot checks burner; child waves from basket; parent points to hills.

still_assets.method: Built-in image_gen; converted to 1200px WebP at quality 84 with Sharp
still_assets.prompt_template: Use case: illustration-story. English writing lesson picture for children aged 7-12. One landscape 3:2 warm painted children’s book illustration. People large and central; clear everyday actions and expressions; hands and relevant objects visible; background secondary. Realistic anatomy. No text, logos, panels or border.
